'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Tony G DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tony G]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''A Dark Time'''. Username '''tazmizzionz'''. Printed list. Dest surname pending — player page [[Tony G]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' tazmizzionz
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
